semantic_generation.class_assignment: Explicit balanced class pairs fixed independently of structure draws; neither dimensions nor occlusion encode class.
semantic_generation.structure_assignment: Separate fixed stratified uniforms transformed through class-conditional categorical distribution; many-to-many stochastic task model, not deterministic class-to-structure code.
semantic_generation.sampling_note: Four quantiles with cyclic parent permutations are a balanced finite development design, not independent random samples.
semantic_generation.uninformative_relationship: Within each parent, each true/visible category receives exactly the same two-structure multiset; paired structures rotate by parent index. Category marginally does not distinguish structure in this finite parent; controller is not told the assignment rule.

No policy endpoint or quality used to select parents. Static infeasibility and resulting parameter corrections retained in this draft.

Same fixed evaluation denominators and all failure records; no dropped undiscovered facilities.
No-feedback means no actual structure-belief correction; mapping, measured support and safety still update while prospective correction remains in planning.

known_structure_reference.extra_information: Exact h only for already observed and uniquely matched instances.
known_structure_reference.trusted_broker: PaidInstanceStructureMatcher privately compares observed marker anchor with true centers within .35 m. Only structure index / unresolved leaves matcher; no position correction or undiscovered-instance list.
known_structure_reference.unresolved: Association uncertain, multiple nearby markers or duplicated identity -> geometry fallback; report reference completeness.
known_structure_reference.planner: Uses common observed support, candidate set, per-h area vectors, exact one-hot weights, route costs and safety.
known_structure_reference.code_review: No direct pose/mesh/future sensor disclosure found. Current controller owns matcher privately; trusted adapter boundary must be respected, not advertised as process-level isolation.
known_structure_reference.required_integration: New runner binds private matcher assets by the same manifest hashes; record per-step disclosures with current observation/source hashes.

No sensor/policy/quality was executed; failed coarse counts retained in initial_navigation_screen.

Shorten SEM_P01 lower baffle x-end 4.8 to 3.8 and move top-left device x=2.2 to 1.8 to clear the x=2.75 access column. Move SEM_P04 right device [8.1,5.1] to [7.7,6.2] closer to the aisle opening. No policy/sensor/quality run was used.

Shorten it to y=6.1 to admit y=6.75 bypass; distinguish a freestanding divider plus anchored divider from two alternating boundary walls. No observed performance informed this change.

static_check_method.geometry: Union of structure_boxes alternatives at fixed dimensions; pairwise 3D AABB separation and conservative public compile_blueprint_graph_v43. No triangle asset or raycast.
static_check_method.front_pose: Original coarse positions, label distance [0.45,2.5]m, normal projection >=0.3m and cosine >=0.4; background/other-device XY line segment unoccluded; nearest 30deg camera heading.
static_check_method.pair_route: All single-view pairs/orders searched for minimum primitive tour; four-view witness uses first two individually cheapest front poses per instance and the best of their 24 orders, so it is not a global minimum over all four-view choices.
static_check_method.candidate_constraint: For each target leg call select_candidate_states_v43(limit=32) with every previously traversed paid camera state excluded. Pick farthest-progress candidate on a shortest path, count each route action plus extra observe, finish with exact-home return. Exists offline; no runtime planner chooses with private targets.
static_check_method.positive_requirement: Each parent has at least one same-class two-instance/two-front-position-per-instance candidate-limited tour <=160. All facilities individually reachable, and report other pair failures without selection.
